name: trakt-mcp
description: Independent Trakt integration: find films and shows, explore watched summaries, and explain personalized recommendations.

interface.shortDescription: Find films and shows with your Trakt account.
interface.longDescription: An independent community integration with four guided workflows: what to watch, watching profile, title search, and connection help. Browse watched summaries and Trakt recommendations. Media tools only read data; login tools change connection state. Not endorsed by Trakt, Anthropic, or OpenAI.
defaultPrompt: Find three movies I might enjoy from my Trakt recommendations.
Summarize patterns in my watched movies and shows.
Help me distinguish the different versions of The Thing.
